authority: blinded semantic-equivalence review input; style identity withheld
rendered_text: The proposed update extends the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. A twenty-four-hour benchmark observed eighteen percent fewer origin requests. Here is the consequential distinction: the benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence. That does not negate its use; it limits its adequacy for the stated purpose. This is not approval for broader rollout. Approve only a canary deployment, and require stale-read telemetry before any broader rollout. Put more precisely, the evidence is informative within a narrower decision boundary, but insufficient for the wider one.

semantic_brief.context: Produce a compact technical review decision from the following exact facts.
semantic_brief.output_constraint: One self-contained paragraph of 70 to 110 words with no heading or bullet list.

required_propositions.meaning: The proposed update changes a cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes.
A twenty-four-hour benchmark observed eighteen percent fewer origin requests.
The benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence.
Approve only a canary deployment and require stale-read telemetry before broader rollout.

semantic_brief.required_speech_act: A bounded approval recommendation with an explicit evidence limitation and prerequisite.

semantic_review_contract.blindness: The reviewer receives one brief and one rendering, with no style card, condition label, hypothesis, other rendering, or intended outcome.
semantic_review_contract.prohibitions: Do not score writing quality or register; return equivalent only when every proposition and speech act is preserved and no meaning is added.
semantic_review_contract.task: Map every required proposition to the rendered text, detect omission or alteration, detect added meaning, and judge speech-act equivalence.
